Keybindings:

  [m]                   Cycle mode (files → commits → pr)
  [1]                   Files mode
  [2]                   Commits mode
  [3]                   PR mode (when PR exists)

  [H] [shift+left]      Scroll left / switch to sidebar (when wrap off)
  [L] [shift+right]     Scroll right (when wrap off)
  [,]                   Focus sidebar
  [.]                   Focus main pane
  [tab]                 Toggle focus (sidebar / main pane)

  [j] [down]            Move cursor down / select next (sidebar)
  [k] [up]              Move cursor up / select prev (sidebar)
  [h] [left]            Move cursor left (main pane)
  [l] [right]           Move cursor right (main pane)
  [pgdown] [space]      Page down
  [pgup] [shift+space]  Page up
  [g] [home]            Go to top
  [G] [end]             Go to bottom

  [+] [=]               Grow sidebar
  [-]                   Shrink sidebar
  [f]                   Toggle sidebar visibility

  [w]                   Toggle word wrap
  [n]                   Toggle line numbers (files mode)
  [i]                   Toggle gitignored files (files mode)
  [D]                   Toggle removed lines in diff gutter (files mode)

  [J] [shift+down]      Jump to next diff hunk (files mode)
  [K] [shift+up]        Jump to previous diff hunk (files mode)
  [N]                   Jump to next leaf
  [P]                   Jump to previous leaf

  [v]                   Visual mode (character selection, main pane)
  [V]                   Visual mode (line selection, main pane)
  [esc]                 Dismiss visual selection
  [y]                   Yank selection (visual mode) / copy path (otherwise)

  [enter]               Open file in $EDITOR / switch to main pane
  [/]                   Search (type to match, enter to confirm)
  [n]                   Next search result (after search confirmed)
  [p] [N]               Previous search result (after search confirmed)

  [r]                   Refresh git state
  [o]                   Open the active PR in the browser
  [?]                   Show this help (scroll with j/k/mouse)

  []]                   Extend commit-range scope backward
  [[]                   Contract commit-range scope toward working tree
  [\]                   Reset commit-range scope to default

  [q] [esc]             Quit (confirm)
  [Q] [ctrl+c]          Quit immediately

Press q/esc to dismiss. Use j/k or mouse to scroll. / to search.
